$meta.name: Hali
$meta.description: A dark first design language for web applications: soft where you touch, crisp where you read. Atlassian structure, Material 3 tonal depth, IBM Carbon rigor.

polar.label: Polar
polar.note: The default. Ink navy surfaces, glacier cyan brand, aurora signals.

aurora.label: Aurora
aurora.note: Deep violet night with a lilac brand.

ember.label: Ember
ember.note: Warm wine-brown and apricot in dark. The light theme is the sunrise one.

midnight.label: Midnight
midnight.note: The darkest. Near black surfaces for late nights and OLED. Light uses Polar.

nord.label: Nord
nord.note: Stock Nord, kept for apps that want the 2.x look.

font.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
font.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
font.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
